# Local override: the upstream `minio/minio` and `minio/mc` Docker Hub repositories are no
# longer publicly pullable, so substitute the Bitnami MinIO images (same CLI/env contract).
services:
  minio:
    image: bitnamilegacy/minio:latest
    user: "0"
  minio-init:
    image: bitnamilegacy/minio-client:latest
--- config check ---
compose config OK

cd /workspace && cat > docker-compose.override.yaml <<'EOF'
# Local override: the upstream `minio/minio` and `minio/mc` Docker Hub repositories are no
# longer publicly pullable, so substitute the Bitnami MinIO images (same CLI/env contract).
services:

    image: bitnamilegacy/minio:latest
    user: "0"
  minio-init:

cat docker-compose.override.yaml; echo "--- config check ---"; docker compose --env-file .env config --quiet 2>&1 && echo "compose config OK"
